gain.text: The host lowers input gain before a loud passage to avoid distortion. Lowering gain cannot repair audio already clipped.

pauses.text: The editor shortens pauses that drag, but preserves meaningful hesitation and reflection.

plosives.text: Angling a microphone slightly away from the mouth softens harsh P and B sounds. It does not eliminate every breath sound.

sync.text: A clap helps line up separately recorded tracks at the start. Editors still need to check for drift later.
